plugins.name: velo
plugins.description: Velo V2 — four modes: Ask (off-axis, read-only conceptual Q&A that never touches the repo), Plan (a persisted, versioned plan saved under .velo/ with an explicit approval freeze — planning only, never execution), Run (executes a frozen, approved plan milestone by milestone, gated by green checks plus one independent review, committing locally — never pushing, merging, or opening PRs), and Auto (spans Plan and Run end-to-end under one explicit approval — nothing is ever auto-approved — gated per milestone by green checks plus a three-cold-reviewer 2-of-3 quorum, with Run's local-commit-only scope, refusing autonomous execution on hosts without subagents). The four-mode surface is complete; no mode is named but unbuilt.
